findings.summary: A missing package.json and an unreadable one both produced reason 'missing', so ce.yml said 'package.json was not found' for a file that exists but could not be read. Spec A8 treats the two cases separately.
findings.fix: Add packageJsonUnreadable to DetectInput, an 'unreadable' fallback reason, and a FALLBACK_REASONS entry.
findings.resolution_note: Resolved. DetectInput.packageJsonUnreadable makes detectProject return reason 'unreadable', and the template now writes 'package.json could not be read'. Carry-forward: T5 must set packageJsonUnreadable for non-ENOENT read errors (the controller will put this in the T5 packet).

findings.summary: The fallback next step hardcoded 'ce.yml' and ignored configPath.
findings.resolution_note: Resolved. The step now uses basename(configPath), so the default case still contains the C1 text 'edit target in ce.yml'.

findings.summary: DEFAULT_PORT was defined in both detect.ts and template.ts.
findings.fix: Export DEFAULT_PORT from detect.ts and import it in template.ts.
findings.resolution_note: Resolved. detect.ts exports DEFAULT_PORT and template.ts imports it.
